title: SpongeBob SquarePants - 1x18 - Nature Pants - Opposite Day

lines.text: SUB BY : DENI AUROR@ https://aurorarental.blogspot.com/ Are you ready, kids?
* who lives in a pineapple under the sea? * * Spongebob Squarepants!
* absorbent and yellow and porous is he. * * Spongebob Squarepants!
* if nautical nonsense be something you wish... * * Spongebob Squarepants!
* then drop on the deck and flop like a fish. * * Spongebob Squarepants!
Mister Krabs, what do we do?
This is the fourth time I've had to scrape you off of something.
We need to get you thinking about work.
No offense, Mister Krabs, but i've been thinking About giving up my cold industrial life In favor of a more natural And free life among the jellyfish.
Ah... Spongebob, you wouldn't last Even one day in the wild.
And this... oh, this is your golden scepter With which you rule!
That's better than nasty old jellyfish, right, Spongebob?
Oh, i can too last more than one day.
Oh, he'll be back, all right.
And, Squidward I want you to have my can opener.
And i thought this friendship would never pay off.
Are you sure you want to give me this mayonnaise?
Patrick, there is one more thing I want you to have.
Hey, Spongebob, you having a garage sale?
No, Sandy, i'm giving up my material possessions To live in the wild with the jellyfish.
Spongebob, of all the crazy schemes Why would you want to live among the jellyfish?
They're cold and mean and none too bright.
Oh, Sandy, that's exactly the response i would expect From someone who lives the sham of a life i once lived.
I'll prove i don't need this stuff to be happy.
Maybe someday you'll wise up and join me.
I'm home, i'm home, i'm home, i'm home, i'm home, i'm home I'm home, i'm home!
Brothers and sisters, wait for me.
My jellyfish instincts tell me to go...
Hello, i'm jellybob-- And you are...?
Here, Patrick, have a krabby patty.
I think i'm getting the hang of this.
If i can't have you as a friend, i'm going to make you a trophy.
I even picked out this nice jar for you.
You're going to look good on my mantel.
So this is the way it's going to be.
Ah, my jellyfish brethren are returning.
Being a jellyfish sure is fun.
Itchy-- Why am i so itchy?
Ow, ow, itch, itch, itch, itch, ow Ooh, ow, ow, ow, itch, itch, itch, itch, itch, itch...
Buzz, buzz, buzz, buzz, buzz Buzz, buzz, buzz, buzz, buzz Buzz, buzz, buzz, buzz Buzz, buzz, buzz, buzz, buzz...
I had a great life and friends, and i gave all of that up.
Ah, quit your blubbering and have a krabby patty.
And i'll see you at work First thing tomorrow morning.
Spongebob, do us all a favor...
It is great to be home!
* pin the tail on the sea horse! * * happy, happy birthday!
Don't do anything i wouldn't do.
I'm moving out of this neighborhood.
I can sell your home in a heartbeat.
Oh, that's great news Because i want to move as soon as possible.
No problem... as long as it's not infested with nematodes Or surrounded by troublesome neighbors Or something like that.
Oh, sure, there's none of that.
Of course! I can't tell you How many times i've seen a sale fall through Because of bad neighbors.
Anyway, i'll be by tomorrow to check out the house.
No one will ever buy my house with him living next door.
Whatever a good neighbor would do, he does the opposite.
Why are you playing the drum?
This is just my wig case, see?
I'll keep you safe Until you're well again.
You don't know what day it is, do you?
Boy, have you been missing out.
Opposite day is the one day of the year When you get to act different.
Normally i'm stuffy and boring But today i'm silly and spontaneous.
Does everybody know about opposite day?
Normally, you're really loud and annoying So what are you going to be today?
Quiet and out of the way.
Why don't you get a jump on it.
I mean, i hate opposite day.
Gary, it's opposite day and i'm-- Walk, don't run-- And i'm going to...
I'm just going to crawl into bed and do nothing all day.
Too bad it only comes once a year, huh, Gary?
I never want to see you again!
Patrick, you're not really not my friend.
Well, whatever you normally do Today you do the opposite.
Let me try, let me try.
Let me show you how to do it... the wrong way.
Say, want to help me Do some work around the house, worst enemy?
Nearly noon and not a peep from Spongebob.
You're the worst neighbor in history.
Wow! That's the nicest thing Squidward has ever said to me.
If the real estate agent sees that mess I'll never sell this house.
I made my house a mess Which was making it clean Which made Squidward clean my yard But that means he's messing it up.
But the opposite of clean is filth Which means filth is clean.
Squidward's making my yard a wreck But i'd normally wreck my own yard So Squidward's being the opposite of Squidward Which means he's Spongebob.
I must be the opposite of Spongebob by being...
I want to be opposite, too.
* i'm Squidward, i'm Squidward * * Squidward, Squidward.
It's not enough to look like Squidward to be opposite.
You have to act like him, too.
Boy, oh, boy, do i like playing the clarinet.
I practice and practice all day long But i never get any better.
* i'm Squidward, Squidward, Squidward, Squidward. * * i'm Squidward, i'm Squidward * Squidward, Squidward.
Next time it's going to be "go jump off a cliff" day.
The house is even more beautiful in person.
I pictured you being much taller.
Now, if you want the sale to go through You've got to tell me All the positive things about your house.
The floor creaks, the roof leaks.
Uh... well, you didn't mention that on the phone.
There's a wild man-Eating clam in the backyard.
Would you care to see the rest?
Well, i'm not sure if i'm interested.
I won't take no for an answer.
And here's the worst room in the house: my gallery.
Oh, my, this painting is very nice.
I'd like to introduce you to mr. Squidward.
At least Spongebob has been quiet.
Okay, i really don't want to hear another one.
I really don't want to hear more, thank you.
I hear you loud and clear.
Oh, oh, i am so sorry, ma'am.
I-I hope these two barnacle-Heads Haven't harmed you in any way.
What kind of fool do you take me for?
I wouldn't sell a house for you If you were the last Squidward on earth!
Let me show you guys how much i hate you.
Patrick, you ever feel That Squidward likes us too much?
